definitions.control: Reconstructed document-owned source/display lifetime plus combined validation/serialization; existing GPU cache, exact worker, publication and memory policies held constant
definitions.quality: Compare architectures within High or Light; no quality change between an A/B pair
definitions.fps: Distinct encoded Perspective frames; not UI callbacks or RDP client video
definitions.repeats: Two alternating A/B pairs per profile at each size; descriptive medians/ranges, no statistical significance claim
definitions.geometry: Identical native source SHA across all eight runs at each size, matched mesh counts per profile and independent source volume/bounds/closedness/solid-count/naked-edge oracles
